fourth_family.commit_message: [FLINK-11436] [avro] Manually Java-deserialize AvroSerializer for backwards compatibility
source_facts: Flink 1.7 changed AvroSerializer serialVersionUID from 1L to 2L.
Some composite serializers remained Java-serialized, so nested old AvroSerializer instances could fail with serialVersionUID mismatch.
FailureTolerantObjectInputStream detects the old AvroSerializer name + UID=1 and substitutes the local class descriptor.
AvroSerializer.readObject manually distinguishes 1.5, 1.6 and current field layouts and reconstructs current fields.
Migration tests contain serialized 1.5/1.6/1.7 payloads and assert successful deserialization into current AvroSerializer state.

presealed_cells.semantics: Old UID descriptor read by ordinary Java deserializer fails compatibility.
Failure-tolerant descriptor substitution plus manual layout reconstruction restores a current object.

property_index_control.semantics: The repair predicate is targeted to old AvroSerializer identity/UID rather than being a property-independent generic bypass.

M4_PROPERTY_INDEPENDENT_EDGE.prediction: If tolerant repair is generic, target and non-target UID mismatches should be repaired alike.

M5_PROPERTY_INDEXED_EDGE.prediction: Target old Avro identity may be repaired while non-target UID mismatch remains rejected.
